title: OFAC SDN Match: MV Volga Express
description: Vessel IMO9432015 flagged against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list. Russian-flagged tanker operating in violation of energy sanctions. Immediate interdiction recommended.

title: IRGC-Linked Vessel Detected: MV Persian Gulf Star
description: Vessel linked to Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sanctioned entity. Operating under deceptive flag. Cargo believed to be crude oil destined for sanctioned state.

title: Sanctions Evasion Suspected: MV Sirocco Spirit
description: Libyan-flagged vessel displaying AIS manipulation. Transponder turned off for 18-hour window near Libyan coast. CAATSA sanctions linkage confirmed.

title: Venezuela Sanctions: MV Orinoco Current
description: PDVSA-linked vessel on active US Treasury Department sanctions list. Attempting port entry at Willemstad. Dutch authorities alerted.

title: Syria Sanctions: MV Euphrates Light
description: Syrian state-owned tanker transiting Mediterranean. Linked to SYTROL company under EU Council Regulation 36/2012. Port ban in effect for EU member states.

title: Houthi Threat: Bab-el-Mandeb Corridor
description: Houthi forces have targeted 3 vessels in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait in the past 48 hours. All vessels transiting through this corridor face elevated missile/drone threat. Alternative Cape of Good Hope routing strongly advised.

title: South China Sea: Disputed Waters Activity
description: Increased Chinese Coast Guard presence in Paracel Islands region. Commercial vessels advised to maintain 50nm exclusion from disputed reefs. EEZ violations being reported.

title: Black Sea: Ukraine Conflict Zone Expansion
description: Ukrainian naval drone activity reported east of 31°E longitude. Russian naval blockade extends to new coordinates. Insurance P&I clubs issuing non-coverage advisories.

title: Tropical Cyclone Approaching Bay of Bengal
description: Tropical Cyclone REMAL intensifying. Category 2 with projected Category 3 by April 7. Forecast track: Bangladesh coastline. 23 vessels in projected path. Immediate diversion recommended.

title: North Atlantic Gale: Force 10 Warning
description: Severe gale warning issued for North Atlantic between 50°N–60°N. Wind speeds 55–65 knots. Wave heights 12–16m. 8 vessels currently in hazard zone advised to seek shelter.

title: Arctic Ice Encroachment: Northern Route
description: Earlier than forecast sea ice advance closing Northern Sea Route. Transit window shortening by 2 weeks. 4 LNG carriers should reroute via Suez Canal.

title: Fog Warning: English Channel
description: Dense sea fog reducing visibility to <100m in Dover Strait. Traffic separation scheme in effect. Speed restrictions applying. VHF Channel 16 mandatory monitoring.

title: Suez Canal: Temporary Closure — Vessel Grounding
description: Bulk carrier aground in Canal kilometer 151. Both northbound and southbound convoys halted. Authority estimates 18–24 hour clearance. 47 vessels in holding pattern.

title: Panama Canal: Water Level Restrictions
description: Reduced draft restrictions remain in effect due to Gatun Lake water levels. Maximum draft 44ft (13.4m). 12 Neopanamax vessels require partial unloading. Delays of 3–5 days.

title: Maritime Cyber Incident: GPS Spoofing Detected
description: GPS spoofing incidents reported in Eastern Mediterranean. Vessels reporting position discrepancies of up to 87nm. ECDIS systems affected. Manual celestial navigation recommended as backup.
